entry.title: Not able to Create Return Delivery Challan.
entry.content:
As per our business process, if a product gets damaged in transit and the customer refuses to accept it, we need to bring the damaged stock back to our nearest plant warehouse. However, the transporter requires a delivery challan to transport and unload the damaged product at our location.

We tried to map this process in SAP by creating a return credit delivery with reference to the credit note, but we could not find a way to configure the copy control from the credit note to the return delivery.

Kindly suggest a suitable SAP solution to meet this business requirement.

entry.title: Issue in creating credit memo request (CR)
entry.content:
We are currently facing an issue while creating Credit Memo Requests for a few materials in the PRD system.

The following error message is displayed:

"Target unit of measure EA is not defined in item 'Sales Org' for material ''."

However, for the same material, customer, and sales area combination, we are able to create Sales Orders (OR), Returns, and other sales documents without any issues. The problem occurs only for a few specific combinations. For the majority of materials, Credit Memo Requests can be created successfully.

The following checks have already been performed:

Verified the Units of Measure maintained in the Material Master, including the Base Unit of Measure and Alternative Units of Measure in the Additional Data tab.
Verified the Sales Unit of Measure in the Material Master, which is maintained correctly.
Verified the Unit of Measure maintained in the Customer-Material Info Record (CMIR), which is also correct.
Checked the relevant Item Category determination and configuration.
Performed a comparison between working and non-working material/customer combinations, but no obvious differences were found.

Could you please help us identify the root cause of this issue?

entry.title: Query regarding Retrofit-SPS Upgarde
entry.content:
We are currently in progress with SPS upgrade (ECC EHP 8, SP25).

As part of it, we need to retrofit few changes (Programs, Smartforms etc.) in the upgraded Development system which were earlier carried out in non-upgraded Quality & Pre-Production systems.

For Programs (with minor changes): We use version management & manually copy the changes to upgraded development system.

For Programs (with multiple includes etc.): We use (TCD SE38 -> Utilities -> More Utilities -> Upload/Download) option to download from quality system & upload it to development system.

For Smartforms/Styles/Text: We use (TCD SMARTFORMS -> Utilities -> Upload/Download form/style/text) option to download from Quality & upload it to development system.

Please can anyone confirm whether the above approach is correct & whether it will have any impact on the ongoing SPS Upgrade.

entry.title: Discrepancy in DMEE Format Name Displayed in F110 DME Administration
entry.content:
Hi Team,

We have created a new DMEE format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1 by copying the existing DMEE format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT.

The new format has been configured and assigned as follows:

  • Assigned to the relevant country payment method in FBZP.
  • Corresponding entries have been created and maintained in OBPM1, OBPM3, and OBPM4 with the format name Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1.
  • The payment method is configured to use the new DMEE format.

During testing in F110, the system consistently updates and uses the new format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1 in the following locations:

  1. Proposal Log
  2. Environment → Payment Media → Attributes
  3. Table REGUT (field DTFOR)
  4. Generated DMEE/XML file details
  5. Runtime data observed during debugging (field FPAYHX-FORMI contains value Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1)
